_comment: OVHcloud dedicated server install config (RISE-L / AMD Ryzen 9 9950X, 2x960GB NVMe soft RAID, Gravelines). Replay this through the OVHcloud API console BEFORE running setup.sh: the OS install happens before any shell exists, so setup.sh cannot reproduce it. Replace sshKey with your own public key first. THE LOAD-BEARING VALUE IS '"mountPoint": "/", "size": 0' -- 0 means 'use all remaining space', which is what yields ~890 GiB on / instead of OVH's default ~20 GB root with the bulk on /home. sccache lives in /var/cache and Docker in /var/lib, both under /, so a small root fills during the first real build.
